review_text_raw: For the third entry in this franchise, the developers once again do something new while sticking to the origins of the simulacra as the evil spirit. I like that the whole ordeal is centered around a quiet little town with a rich history as Stonecreek. It sets up some cool horror vibes. Unfortunately for me I didn't like the Atlas app used to view the town. On the other hand, a highlight of this game is when you interact with the Vanguard app and view the evil spirit through the camera system, while you try to get your partner to safety. While I ended up getting a good ending, for me it fell flat and the story just sort of suddenly stopped.
